text:
Nina: Heads-up — proposing a dry-run of the restore runbook and multi-region failover tests next week. Window: Thu 03/26 03:00-05:00 UTC. Need concrete owners for: backups validation, routing tests, DB restore sanity checks, and a facilitator. Draft agenda below. @Zeynep can you lead?

Zeynep (oncall): I can lead the run. Prefer a two-phase approach: 1) backups + metadata validation, 2) limited routing failover to canary region. Avoid full traffic flip.

Jorge: +1 on canary. I'll take routing test ownership. I'll prepare a small traffic generator and a health-check script.

Erin: I can own DB restore sanity checks. We'll use a read-only replica in the secondary region and run the smoke queries. ETA to prepare scripts: Tue EOD.

Sam (SRE): I'll validate S3/backup integrity and ensure PITR snapshots are listed and accessible. Need a short checklist in the runbook for exact S3 paths and IAM roles.

Nina: Draft agenda (for the runbook doc):
- Pre-checks (IAM, quotas, manifests)
- Backup validation (S3 & DB PITR) — owner: Sam
- Restore to staging replica & smoke tests — owner: Erin
- Canary routing test (5% traffic) — owner: Jorge
- Observability & rollback validation — owner: Zeynep
- Post-run lessons + playbook edits — facilitator: Nina

Jorge: Here's the routing test command I'll run (local devnet):
```
# spin up 5 qps generator against canary region
./traffic-gen --target=https://canary.redwood-inference.internal --qps=5 --duration=600
```

Sam (SRE): Backup verification snippet I'll use:
```
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-backups/prod/ --recursive --human-readable --summarize | grep $(date -d '1 day ago' +%F)
pg_restore --list latest_pitr.dump | head -n 20
```

Erin: Smoke queries I'll run after restore: simple tokenized completion tests + indexing check. Adding them to the runbook section `restore-smoke-tests`.

Nina: Action items with dates:
- Sam: post backup checklist to runbook by Tue 03/24 23:59 UTC
- Erin: restore scripts + smoke tests by Tue 03/24 23:59 UTC
- Jorge: traffic generator & health-check script by Wed 03/25 12:00 UTC
- Zeynep: run facilitation notes and rollback decision tree by Wed 03/25 18:00 UTC
- Nina: schedule calendar invite and runbook PR by Wed 03/25 20:00 UTC

Zeynep (oncall): Can we add a short mitigation play: if cross-region DB restore takes >30m, abort and snapshot current state. I'll add to the rollback section.

Jorge: Do we want a failover tag on logs and a metric to watch for canary errors? I can add a temporary dashboard.

Sam (SRE): Good call. Add metric: failover.canary.errors and a synthetic check that fails if 5xx rate > 1% for 5 minutes.

Nina: Scheduling note: please mark yourself "busy" for the window. I'll create the calendar event after folks confirm.

Erin: Confirmed.

Jorge: Confirmed.

Sam (SRE): Confirmed.

Zeynep (oncall): Confirmed. I'll also notify oncall-rotation and add the postmortem tracking labels if anything unexpected shows up.

deploy-bot: calendar event created: "Restore runbook dry run — Thu 03/26 03:00-05:00 UTC" (invited: Nina, Jorge, Erin, Sam (SRE), Zeynep (oncall)).

Nina: Thanks everyone. After the run we'll consolidate action items and open follow-up tasks in the DR epic. Plan: run, capture timestamps, update runbook with exact commands and observed timing. :thumbsup:

Erin: Suggestion: record the session (screenshare + commands) for async review.

Zeynep (oncall): Agreed — I'll start the meeting recording and ensure logs are archived to the DR bucket.

Nina: OK closing thread for scheduling. I'll post the PR link to the runbook here once ready.
